headline: South Korea Ruling Party Seeks Two-Year Delay on Crypto Tax Implementation
summary: South Korea's ruling party aims to delay the implementation of a cryptocurrency tax by approximately two years while awaiting global tax-sharing rules and new digital asset legislation.
why: South Korea is a major hub for cryptocurrency trading and adoption, making regulatory and tax developments in the country significant for digital asset markets and investors.

impacts.name: Cryptocurrency market
impacts.why: Tax policy changes can influence trading volume and sentiment in South Korea's digital asset market.
